summary: Tested Linesheet save/share drafts feature end-to-end. All 8 backend pytest cases pass (POST/GET/PUT/duplicate/share-view-increment/share-404/DELETE). Frontend: login, navigate to Linesheet, ctx dropdown has ONLY Customer + Price list (no generic), Customer branch shows ls-customer-search/list, Price list branch shows ls-pricelist select. Selected 2 items, picked customer c1, set title, save -> badge 'Saved just now'; edit title -> 'Unsaved changes'; save changes -> 'Saved just now'; ls-save-as-new creates duplicate (drawer entries increased). ls-copy-link copied /share/<token> URL to clipboard. ls-open-saved shows drawer with entries; ls-saved-open restores title and selection. Duplicate via drawer creates 3rd entry. Delete via drawer removes entry. ls-new resets to 'New draft'. Preview shows ls-preview-share and ls-doc. Fresh incognito context loaded /share/<token> -> share-page + ls-doc + share-print/share-download rendered; invalid token -> share-error. No non-chart console errors. Cleaned up 3 TEST_ linesheets via API.
